answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones. Consider a nectar as the anchor of the cost. A raven stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a cipher...
